items.quote: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel
items.claim: Moses, Aaron and his sons shall encamp before the tabernacle toward the east and keep the charge of the sanctuary
items.place: before the tabernacle toward the east

items.quote: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death
items.claim: Strangers that come near the sanctuary shall be put to death
